ignoreModerators.label: Ignore Moderators
ignoreModerators.helpText: If enabled, posts submitted by subreddit moderators will NOT receive any automated comments.

ignoreApprovedUsers.label: Ignore Approved Users
ignoreApprovedUsers.helpText: If enabled, posts submitted by approved submitters will NOT receive any automated comments.

pinComment.label: Pin Bot Comment (Sticky)
pinComment.helpText: If enabled, the bot will automatically distinguish and sticky its generated comment to the top of the post.

excludedFlairs.label: Ignored Post Flairs (Comma separated)
excludedFlairs.helpText: Posts with these exact flairs will be ignored (case-insensitive). If an excluded flair is added later, pending timers are cancelled and bot comments are deleted.

waitTimeSeconds.label: Wait Time (Seconds)
waitTimeSeconds.helpText: Delay in seconds before the bot executes and comments on the post.

enableStandard.label: Enable Standard Comment
enableStandard.helpText: If enabled, posts will receive a standard comment unless excluded.

standardComment.label: Standard Comment Text
standardComment.helpText: The default comment text to post. Use {{author}} to mention the post creator.

enableKeyword.label: Enable Keyword Comments
enableKeyword.helpText: If enabled, posts matching specific keywords or regex patterns receive a dedicated comment.

keywordRules.label: Keyword Rules
keywordRules.defaultValue: help => Hello {{author}}, here is our help center!;; regex:\b(bug|issue)\b => Hi {{author}}, please report bugs in our tracker thread.
keywordRules.helpText: Format: 'keyword => comment'. For regex matching, use 'regex:pattern => comment'. Separate multiple rules with double semicolons (;;) or newlines. First match wins.

matchBehavior.label: Match Behavior
matchBehavior.helpText: Defines whether both standard and keyword comments are posted when a keyword matches.
